description:
The food.gdt dataset is open in Gretl, containing household food expenditure and income data. Perform a Box-Cox transformation test to determine the optimal functional form for the relationship.

1. Go to the menu 'Variable' > 'Box-Cox transformation'.
2. In the dialog, select 'food_exp' as the Variable to transform and 'income' as the Regressor (add it to the list).
3. Click OK to run the test.
4. Analyze the results window which shows the estimated lambda and Likelihood Ratio tests.
5. Save the complete text output to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/box_cox_results.txt' using the Save icon or File > Save to file in the results window.
